headline: MIDAR Introduces Accelerated Schedules and Penalties in Mostakbal City
summary: MIDAR for Investment and Urban Development implemented revised construction schedules and financial penalties for developers failing to meet project deadlines across Mostakbal City in New Cairo.
why: Master developers enforce project timelines to ensure master-planned communities are delivered on schedule, impacting contractor cash flows and project completion rates.
